title: Несмотря на: формальная оговорка
description: Несмотря на: формальная оговорка: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Сохранять факт препятствия и ограниченный вывод
notes: Notwithstanding the delay означает despite the delay; это формальный регистр.
Оговорка допускает основной вывод вопреки обстоятельству, но не отрицает само обстоятельство.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: Choose the formal equivalent of “despite the delay”: ___ the delay.
exercises.explanation: Notwithstanding может предшествовать именной группе the delay.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: delay / delayed.

public_payload.sentence: Notwithstanding the ___, the report was submitted.

exercises.editorial_answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the report was submitted.
exercises.explanation: После notwithstanding здесь нужна именная группа, не отдельная глагольная форма.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Несмотря на задержку, отчёт оставался полезным.»
exercises.editorial_answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the report remained useful.
exercises.explanation: Оговорка не отменяет ни задержку, ни ограниченную оценку полезности.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: Notwithstanding of the delay, the report remained useful.

accepted: Notwithstanding the delay, the report remained useful.

exercises.reference_answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the report remained useful.
exercises.incorrect_answer: Notwithstanding of the delay, the report remained useful.
exercises.editorial_answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the report remained useful.
exercises.explanation: В этой конструкции notwithstanding не требует of.

public_payload.passage: The committee described the archive report as useful, notwithstanding the delay in its submission. A shortened account later claimed that the committee had found no delay worth mentioning. That was not what the sentence said. The timing problem remained part of the record; the committee simply judged that it did not erase the report’s value. Members still requested a revised timetable for future submissions. Their assessment therefore combined recognition of an obstacle with a limited positive conclusion. Removing the qualification would make the record less accurate, while treating it as a rejection of the whole report would distort the assessment in the opposite direction.

options.label: The report was rejected as wholly useless.
The delay occurred, but the report still had value.

exercises.editorial_answer: The delay occurred, but the report still had value.
exercises.explanation: Оговорка сохраняет задержку, а основная часть — полезность.

exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: notwithstanding — несмотря на; obstacle — препятствие; revision — пересмотр; reservation — оговорка.
